key_insight: EvoDiff selects informative real ultrasound images for annotation, approaching fully supervised performance with substantially fewer labels.
clinical_relevance: The framework could reduce expert annotation demands when developing ultrasound AI across organs and centers.
method: Combines diffusion modeling, information gain, evolutionary search, and curriculum-based sampling.
Generates synthetic feature-space probes to retrieve informative unlabeled images.
Uses only retrieved real images—not synthetic probes—for annotation and downstream training.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covered six benchmarks, 15 datasets, and 16,696 images using convolutional and transformer-based models; a six-radiologist reader study yielded model-based estimates of 24%–84% less annotation workload at matched downstream performance.
watch_item: Estimated annotation savings require prospective workflow validation and do not establish clinical diagnostic benefit.
paper_title: Generative Active Learning for Label-Efficient Pan-Organ Ultrasound Diagnosis
